Couloir de la Section 4, dix-neuf heures:
Section 4 corridor, seven in the evening. Every other ceiling light is off. Mrs BRANDT is waiting in front of your door, two cups in her hands.

"Inspector VOSK. Two minutes. About your file: yours, this time." She hands you a cup. It isn't a question.
BRANDT ne regarde pas le papier. « Je l': BRANDT doesn't look at the paper. "I've already read it, Inspector. I'm the one who filed it."
Elle sourit, satisfaite. « Vous partez à: She smiles, satisfied. "You leave at four, except on the days you stay late. On those days you walk home along the quay, not by tram. I only wanted to check I wasn't mistaken." She wasn't.
« Ma sœur ne sait rien de mon travail. »: "My sister knows nothing about my work."
« Bien. » Elle l'écrit. « C'est mieux po: "Good." She writes it down. "It's better for her. The nurses talk a lot at Hospital No. 2."
Elle repose sa tasse. « Vous lui avez pa: She puts her cup down. "You told her about a crossed-out name, on the phone. The hall phone booths have ears, Inspector. Don't lie to me: it's the one thing I don't forgive."
« Il est mieux tenu que le vôtre. » Elle: "It's better kept than yours." She hesitates. "There's a room on the second floor, Room 3. The clock there runs slow. Your father had measured it." She falls silent, as if she had said too much, and takes the cup back from you.
« Et votre dossier à vous, qui le tient: "And your own file, who keeps it?"
Un temps. « Le même service que le vôtre: A pause. "The same department as yours. We are all kept, Inspector. The only question is: by whom, and for how long." For the first time, she looks down.
« Encore une note sur moi, et je parle d: "One more note about me, and I tell the Directorate about the slips signed 'B.'"
Elle sort un carnet et écrit votre phras: She takes out a notebook and writes your sentence down, word for word. "Thank you. It saves me rephrasing it." She walks away unhurried. Her heels echo all the way to the stairs.
Mme BRANDT rince les deux tasses au lava: Mrs BRANDT rinses the two cups at the corridor basin. "Until tomorrow, Inspector. I'm noting that you were pleasant. I note everything."
